english.title: Prevent other from appearing before an authorised person / answering question pursuant to s. 108(4)
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse prevented **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) from

(A)_[appearing before **(..SPECIFY AUTHORISED PERSON..), an authorised person,]_
(B)_[answering a question to which an authorised person, namely **(..SPECIFY AUTHORISED PERSON..), may have required an answer]_

pursuant to section 108(4) of the Environment Act 1995
english.legislation: Contrary to section 110(2)(c) and (5) of the Environment Act 1995.

english.notes:
(i) Authorised person means a person authorised under section 108(4) and includes a person designated under paragraph 2 of Schedule 18 to the Environment Act 1995.
(ii) Powers and duties includes powers or duties exercisable by virtue of a warrant under Schedule 18 to the Environment Act 1995.
(iii) See alternative offence under section section 110(3D) and penalty under 110(3E) when the offence is committed against a person authorised by the Agency or the NRBW and the operation was in respect of water undertaker / sewerage undertaker or water supply licensee / sewerage licensee: H102037.
(iv) See section 110(5I) for offences committed by body corporate.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
